summary: Independent Luna re-review of PR #1293 head 64e8ce15 remains NO-GO: unprefixed sudoers grants can escape inventory, a symlinked snapshot-root ancestor is resolved before no-follow validation, and the positive fixture depends on a commit absent from a normal PR checkout.
validation: Exact PR head 64e8ce15479c9b1c500427bd98cf2d85426a4f1d reviewed against base efb9faac0606e02b7cac8e36e716f1ede9a50fb6.
Verifier, contract, and tests were reviewed against the prior five findings and the high-risk acceptance matrix.
PR Validate, Legacy Freeze Guard, and ARC classifier currently pass; the trusted ARC producer job remains queued and is not merge evidence.
blockers: Inventory every sudoers.d file or fail closed when any undeclared file can grant the agent additional authority; add an unprefixed sudo-policy mutation test.
Validate the user-supplied snapshot root component-by-component before any resolve operation so symlinked ancestors cannot bypass no-follow guarantees.
Make the positive fixture self-contained in a normal PR checkout rather than requiring an unfetched diverged commit.
Add focused fail-closed tests for missing and permission-denied roots, malformed service state, and service/workspace metadata races.
next_action: Return to the Luna code owner for focused remediation, then independently re-review the new exact head before entering test stage.

issues.title: Unprefixed sudoers grants escape privileged inventory
issues.details: The verifier ignores unprefixed files in sudoers.d, so an undeclared file can broaden the agent's root command boundary without detection.

issues.title: Snapshot-root symlinked ancestors resolve before validation
issues.details: Resolving the supplied root before validating its original component chain permits a symlinked ancestor to bypass the intended no-follow trust check.

issues.title: Positive fixture is not portable to normal PR checkout
issues.details: The fixture reads blobs from a diverged immutable commit that the PR workflow does not fetch, causing setup failure before verifier behavior is exercised.

issues.title: Remaining fail-closed acceptance paths lack focused coverage
issues.details: Missing-root, permission, malformed service state, and metadata race cases require deterministic adversarial tests.
